title: A tiny engine core
description:
Put together a fixed-step loop, entities with components, and input actions into one small engine core.

```
frame 1: input "right" -> player velocity (1, 0)
step x2 (fixed 1/60) -> player at (0.033, 0)
render alpha 0.4 -> drawn at (0.023, 0)
120 frames run, 120 steps, no frame skipped
```
hints: Keep the previous position for each entity so `render` can draw `previous + (current - previous) * alpha` (lesson 10.02).
Build it from the pieces of this milestone's practice tasks, one at a time, testing each.
requirements: Entities with Position and Velocity in component stores; an input system sets the player's velocity.
A main loop that feeds simulated frame times and input, and prints a few frames.
stretch: Draw it for real with raylib or a Win32 window.
